description_en: Queries the execution result of an asynchronous task for Network Load Balancer (NLB)
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡的异步任务执行结果信息
name: GetJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Succeeded: The task succeeded.
Processing: The task is in progress
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Succeeded：成功。
Processing：执行中
